takeaway: 后面接人、事物或动名词。

forms.label: 词条基本形式
forms.note: 指负责某事或主管某人；不要混淆 in the charge of。

senses.title: 负责；主管
senses.usageNote: 介词短语；be in charge of 表示某人负责某事。

examples.en: She is in charge of the school library.
He is in charge of organizing the meeting.

collocations.en: be in charge of a project

relatedExpressions.similarNote: 易混表达的区别见“近义与易混”。
relatedExpressions.contrastingNote: 具体关系应结合语境判断。

confusions.title: in charge of 与 in the charge of

example.en: She is in charge of the project.
The project is in the charge of her team.
example.zh: 这个项目由她的团队负责。

confusions.takeaway: in charge of 指负责；in the charge of 指由某人负责或照管，主语的角色相反。
